name: Briosco (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Briosco (a red castle on light blue) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI BRIOSCO in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Briosco, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Briosco arms — red castle on light blue, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI BRIOSCO beneath the arms
